ratios.facility: Credit Facility (Amended and Restated Credit Agreement)

parsed.notes: The leverage ratio is a debt-to-capitalization measure in percent (60% means 0.60), not a debt/EBITDA multiple. The covenant table also lists dollar-based covenants that are not ratios and are excluded: minimum tangible net worth (requirement > $3,794,870K, actual $5,044,702K) and investments other than permitted investments (limit < $1,538,411K, actual $60,762K). The debt-to-capital (26.6%) and net debt-to-capital (17.4%) figures are non-GAAP measures not tied to the covenant and are excluded. Pricing-grid leverage references only set margins and fees.
